## Reviso audit — detached HEAD 1950a51102 vs b8c1cd410f4499c77a8b372decfe1718b80ccfd2 (1 commit, 10 files)
Base: b8c1cd410f4499c77a8b372decfe1718b80ccfd2 via flag — merge-base b7b84d75d1

Found 2 issues:

1. [P1][conf 95] Global view permission bypasses client-specific denials — services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/ClientPermissionsV2.java:78
   Failure: An all-clients VIEW grant causes canView(client) to return true before evaluating an explicit denial for that client. Collection listing also bypasses individual checks when global canView() succeeds.
   Fix: Reserve unconditional view shortcuts for built-in roles; evaluate client-specific permissions before global fallback and preserve that precedence in list filtering.
   (bugs; corroborated by history)

2. [P1][conf 90] Global manage permission fails inherited list and view checks — services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/ClientPermissionsV2.java:87
   Failure: An administrator granted only all-clients MANAGE can create clients and client scopes but receives 403 when listing them without query roles. With query-clients, the client-scope list is empty.
   Fix: Include MANAGE in the global view decision while preserving client-specific permission precedence.
   (bugs)

Checked: bugs, conventions, history, deterministic.
Not checked: comments, slop, prior-reviews (host agent-thread limit).
Skipped: nothing.

findings.title: Global view permission bypasses client-specific denials
findings.failure_scenario: An administrator has an all-clients VIEW grant and an explicit VIEW denial on a sensitive client. canView(client) accepts the global grant before evaluating the client-specific resource, exposing the denied client.
findings.suggested_fix: Short-circuit only for built-in administrative roles, evaluate client-specific permissions before global fallback, and make collection filtering respect those individual decisions.
findings.evidence: ClientPermissionsV2.java:78 accepts global canView() before the specific-resource evaluation at lines 214–224; ClientsResource.java:153 likewise bypasses individual checks when global view succeeds. UserResourceTypeEvaluationTest.java:203–212 and reachable commit bf355f83d3 establish that an individual denial takes precedence over an all-resource grant.

findings.title: Global manage permission fails inherited list and view checks
findings.failure_scenario: An administrator granted only all-clients MANAGE can create clients and client scopes but receives 403 when listing either collection without query roles. Adding query-clients permits the client-scope request but returns an empty list.
findings.suggested_fix: Include the all-clients MANAGE scope in the global view decision while preserving client-specific permission precedence.
findings.evidence: ClientPermissionsV2.java:73 and :109 accept global MANAGE, but :87 checks only VIEW; inherited ClientPermissions.java:241–259 and :489 derive collection access from canView(). ClientScopesResource.java:91–95 requires list permission and returns an empty stream when canViewClientScopes() is false.
